skill.summary: YouTubers, content creators, educators add video files into captioned videos using this skill. Accepts MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB, renders on cloud GPUs...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Best Subtitles: Generate and embed captions in videos using cloud GPU processing.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB; renders 1080p MP4 output in 30–90 seconds.
- Anonymous users receive a free token via automatic setup, no installation required.
- Handles subtitle generation, multi-language tracks, and supports YouTubers, educators, and content creators.
- Clear workflows for uploading, credit checking, exporting, and timeline state preview.
- Robust error handling and session management ensure smooth, reliable experience.
